name: USDKG
notes: OSL listing source reviewed; USDKG is described as a state-supervised USD-pegged stablecoin backed by physical gold and listed for professional investors. Primary issuer/state evidence is still required before stronger legal, reserve or redemption assertions.

name: litUSD
notes: Stably launch case study reviewed; litUSD launched on Ethereum in August 2025, is issued by Brale, backed 1:1 by cash and cash equivalents, and mintable/redeemable at parity by verified Brale users. Exact launch day and contract identity require additional primary capture.
